en.headline: HKEX posts record first-half profit of HK$10.57 billion
en.dek: Second-quarter net profit rose 21 per cent to HK$5.38 billion, beating estimates, as average daily turnover hit a quarterly high and IPO fundraising nearly doubled.
body: Hong Kong Exchanges and Clearing reported a record first-half profit of HK$10.57 billion, up 24 per cent from a year earlier, driven by strong trading volumes and a surge in initial public offerings.

Net profit for the second quarter alone rose 21 per cent year on year to HK$5.38 billion, or HK$4.26 per share, exceeding analysts’ estimates. It was the second consecutive quarter of record earnings after the first-quarter figure of HK$5.19 billion.

Average daily turnover on the cash market reached a quarterly high of HK$289.5 billion, up 22 per cent. Funds raised from 87 new listings in the first half totalled HK$212.4 billion, nearly double the amount a year earlier, with technology and AI-related companies prominent.

HKEX will pay an interim dividend of HK$7.43 per share, 24 per cent higher than a year ago. Chief Executive Bonnie Chan said the results were supported by robust market sentiment and active participation from both mainland and international investors.

zh.headline: 港交所上半年盈利創新高達105.7億元
zh.dek: 第二季純利升21%至53.8億元，勝過預期；日均成交創季度新高，IPO集資額近乎倍增。
body: 香港交易及結算所有限公司公布，2026年上半年純利達105.7億元，按年上升24%，創半年度新高，主要受交易量上升及首次公開招股活躍帶動。
第二季純利按年升21%至53.8億元，相當於每股4.26元，勝過分析師預期。這是連續第二季錄得紀錄盈利，首季純利為51.9億元。
現貨市場日均成交額達2,895億元，升22%，創季度新高。上半年共有87宗新上市，集資額2,124億元，接近上年同期一倍，科技及人工智能相關公司表現突出。
港交所將派發中期股息每股7.43元，按年升24%。行政總裁陳翊庭表示，業績受市場氣氛良好以及內地與國際投資者積極參與支持。
